# v6.0.0 — Module 6: Supply Chain Relationships

This major release adds the sixth completed module and connects customer, supplier, alliance, and communication decisions to the existing demand, network, sourcing, operations, and logistics curriculum.

## Included

- two connected sections covering Customer Relationships and Supplier and Supply Chain Relationships
- 32 topic lessons and 40 Module 6 Markdown learning/reference pages
- 32 original SVG decision visuals and 12 fictional CSV datasets
- 69 independently authored knowledge checks
- a relationship-performance formula and control sheet
- the integrated ClearSpan Customer-Supplier Relationship Stabilization capstone with a fully worked solution
- Module 6 navigation in the root README, roadmap, glossary, learning paths, and citation metadata

## Quality controls

- locked 32-topic source-to-public coverage and duplication boundaries
- independent data/formula recalculation and gate validation
- normal- and narrow-width raster review of all 32 SVGs
- cross-module target verification against the Modules 1–5 baseline
- exact normalized source/public overlap scanning with zero 10-word or 12-word hits
- one shared repository validator extended to the sixth completed module
- proprietary curriculum files, private audits, question-bank material, and render-check artifacts excluded from the public tree
